What to expect

Learn from the best

Workshops range from half-day sessions to multi-day intensives, taught by Guild members and visiting instructors alike. They run throughout the year — usually in person in Bloomington, with some offered on Zoom — and most are open to members and non-members alike. Kit fees vary by class and are paid with registration, so watch the calendar for what's coming up.

Where we meet

Most workshops are held in person at Minnesota Valley Unitarian Universalist Fellowship (MVUUF) in Bloomington; a few are offered on Zoom. The exact venue is confirmed with each workshop on the calendar. We would love to have you.

Usual location
Minnesota Valley Unitarian Universalist Fellowship
10715 Zenith Avenue South
Bloomington, MN 55431
Registering & kit fees

Register through the calendar — open any workshop to sign up. Kit fees vary by class and are paid with registration, and most workshops are open to members and non-members alike. When a session is on Zoom, the link is sent with your registration.
